_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The coil holds at the Disbelief threshold with neither organic buying confirmation (fear_greed >35, momentum >60) nor risk-off invalidation (VIX >20, DXY >101) present to force a directional break.
next_move.brains_agree: Split — analyst explicitly calls HOLD citing no breaker; narrative implies upside reversal but provides no trigger; consensus sides with analyst's higher trust weight and the 5% directional-move base rate
next_move.confirmed_if: fear_greed breaks above 35 with BTC momentum_30d >60 and funding stays <0.01%
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX >20 with DXY >101 and BTC funding >0.015%, or MVRV Z-score drops below 15 with stablecoin growth contracting
